skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities with a common denominator by operating on numerators and interpreting zero, positive, or negative interim fractional differences.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Manage mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Decompose mixed or whole-number operands into whole and fractional parts, treat missing fractional parts as zero, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractions when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result or the fractional part of a mixed number to lowest terms.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions or fraction parts as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fraction parts once they have a common denominator, including cases with zero numerators or zero fractional parts.

skills.name: Handle whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole quantities into whole-number and fractional parts, subtract the whole-number parts, and recombine or retain the whole-number result with the fraction result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractions when the fractional minuend is too small to subtract the fractional subtrahend.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator for unlike fractions and convert the fractions to equivalent like-denominator forms.

skills.name: Separate and combine whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers, whole numbers, and fractions using whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts separately, and combine the resulting parts into a final answer.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result or fractional part to lowest terms.

skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fraction parts that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Separate and combine mixed or whole numbers
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers, whole numbers, or pure fractions as whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts, and combine the resulting parts.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-equivalent fractional units when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize final result
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms and normalize answers by removing zero whole or fractional parts when appropriate.

skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they share a denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and simplifying or removing any zero fractional result.

skills.name: Common-denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite fractions or fractional parts as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Mixed and whole number part management
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers, whole numbers, or pure fractions with appropriate whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts, handle missing zero parts, and recombine the final result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction would be negative, borrow one or more whole units and convert each borrowed unit into denominator-sized fractional units.
